# Regime adaptive Pine audit and DSL conversion

## Problem and scope

Audit the supplied Regime-Based Adaptive Strategy v4.1 and repair execution and sizing issues before interpreting backtests. Identify exact DSL support rather than substitute a different strategy.

## Completed preparation lanes

- Pine worker (Luna): `docs/research/regime-adaptive/pine/` only; preserve original and corrected research Pine.
- DSL worker (Luna): `docs/research/regime-adaptive/dsl/` only; capability mapping and executable translation only if supported.
- Test worker (Luna): `scripts/research/regimeAdaptive*`, `test/regimeAdaptive*`, `docs/research/regime-adaptive/testing/` only; reproducible independent checks.
- Orchestrator: evidence summary and integration. Preparation claims cleared; no worker remains editing. Branch: `codex/regime-adaptive-pine`. No edits to shared user checkout. No parser changes without producer release.

## Acceptance

- Preserve supplied source and document each behavior change.
- Check causal indicators, quantity units, order timing, scale-in and exit lifecycle.
- Provide exact DSL mapping or explicit producer gaps; do not call an approximation parity.
- Record reproducible test evidence and limitations of screenshot results.

## Validation

Focused deterministic research tests, Pine compiler/browser checks when available, `pnpm test` for strategy/money logic, and `git diff --check`.

## Integration

Preparation PR: https://github.com/spik3r/heisentick/pull/493 (commit `90f6f23408c16175dde822f1e1f2b70ea25a374d`). Full suite did not pass: pnpm bootstrap fetch failed; underlying runner had missing clean-worktree dependencies and was interrupted. Pine compilation and XAUUSD market-data parity remain unverified. Owner handoff: review the corrected single-position Pine baseline and producer contract; exact DSL integration remains open. DSL producer changes, if needed, require heisentick-strat PR, tagged release, and consumer pin bump before integrated parity.

PR493 CI: Terraform validation stopped before setup because the runner had 1.8 GiB free and the job requires 2 GiB. Job: https://github.com/spik3r/heisentick/actions/runs/38540723120/job/115774504947 . Policy checks were still pending at handoff. No merge performed.
